entries.rule: Tutor: Must have the skill at Attribute+2 or higher. Max 3 students at a time.
Self-study: Requires a book, manual, or practice space (included in the cost).
A skill cannot exceed Attribute+1 through study alone.
Beyonder potion-granted skills (Chapters 9–11) cannot be studied.
No more than two skills may be studied per downtime period.
